F1.recordedOutcome: The repository's Current Remediation Workflow explicitly records F1 as corrected and verified. This curated record imports that scoped remediation decision and links the executable regressions; it is not a fresh test execution.
F1.environment: Recorded remediation: isolated real Neo4j regressions and fixture/unit coverage. The Explorer never runs database tests.
F1.limitations: No raw execution transcript or passing-test count is stored with the remediation instruction. Verification is attributed to that explicit repository decision. The revision locates the correction; its commit message is not proof. Dependency coverage conservatively includes all production modules, configuration, migrations, dependency locks and existing tests.
